title: Offline - complete soundtrack (60.000 s)
note: Cue sheet for audio/mix.py. Built to the final frame numbers of TREATMENT.md and the sample-exact music edit of audio/music_edit.json. Only licensed recordings; processing is editing, gain, filters, tape/rubberband pitch, and convolution with three recorded room impulse responses (Zenodo, CC BY 4.0). Buses: music, amb (beds), fx, foley (close, dry), plus one return bus per reverb. Each cue carries a _comment with its shot and purpose. Generated by audio/build_cues.py (edit that, not this file). Report: audio/CUES.md.
